snippet.title: Poly Fighter: Bonus Stages - First Look CGA'26 Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3977340/Poly_Fighter/

Poly Fighter is HeartLoop Games' debut title, blending fighting game intensity with roguelike progression to deliver a unique, expansive single-player experience.

Choose your fighter, select your opponent, and defeat them to learn their techniques, building your own moveset as you grow stronger and push towards victory.

Now, with bonus stages: Wave Survival, Statue Break, Item Smash, and more to come!
Wishlist now on Steam. https://store.steampowered.com/app/3977340/Poly_Fighter/

#polyfighter #roguelike #cga2026
